1: Qaaf. Aise huroof ke baare mein guftagu Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hai. Allah izzat wale Quran ki qasam khata hai un maani, bohat si bhalai aur barkaton ki wajah se jo us mein hain. Woh is baat par qasam khata hai ke tum zaroor Qayamat ke din hisaab aur badle ke liye uthaye jaoge.
2: Un ke jhutlane ki wajah yeh na thi ke unhein aap se jhoot ki tawaqqo thi, kyunke woh aap ki amanatdari jaante hain. Balke woh is par hairan hain ke ek darane wala Rasool un ke paas un hi ki jins se aaya, farishton mein se nahin. Woh hairani se kehte hain: 'Ek insan Rasool ka hamare paas aana ajeeb baat hai!'
3: 'Kya hum marne aur mitti ban jaane ke baad dobara uthaye jaayenge? Dobara uthna, aur hamare jismon ke gal jaane ke baad un mein zindagi ka lautna ek door ki baat hai; yeh na-mumkin hai ke aisa ho.'
4: Beshak Hum jaante hain ke zameen un ki maut ke baad un ke jismon ka kitna hissa kha jaati hai; woh Hum se poshida nahin. Hamare paas ek kitab hai jo har us cheez ko mehfooz rakhti hai jo Hum ne un ke liye un ki zindagiyon mein aur un ki maut ke baad tay ki.
5: Balke in mushrikon ne Quran ko jhutlaya jab us ka Rasool use un ke paas laaya. Woh us ke baare mein be-yaqeeni mein hain; woh us ke baare mein kisi baat par qayam nahin reh sakte.
6: Kya dobara uthne ke yeh munkir apne oopar ke aasman par gaur nahin karte: ke Hum ne use kaise paida kiya, use banaya aur un sitaron se sajaya jo Hum ne us mein rakhe, aur us mein koi daraar nahin jo use kharab kare? Woh hasti jis ne yeh aasman paida kiya murdon ko zinda uthane se aajiz nahin.
7: Aur Hum ne zameen ko us tareeqe se phailaya jo us par rehne ke laayaq hai, us mein mazboot pahaad rakh kar taake woh hile na. Hum ne us par har tarah ke khoobsoorat podhe aur darakht bhi ugaye.
8: Hum ne yeh sab ek roshni aur nasihat ke tor par paida kiya har us bande ke liye jo farmanbardari mein apne Rubb ki taraf rujoo karta hai.
9: Aur Hum aasman se baarish ka paani utarte hain, jis mein bohat se faide aur bhalai hai. Us paani se Hum phir baagh ugate hain aur woh khetiyan jo tum kaatte ho, jaise jau wagera.
10: Hum lambi khajooren bhi ugate hain, jin mein ek ke oopar doosre tah-ba-tah pass pass lage phool hote hain.
11: Hum yeh sab bandon ke rizq ke tor par ugate hain taake woh us mein se khayein. Hum baarish ke paani se banjar zameenon ko bhi zinda karte hain jin mein koi ugaav nahin, aur jaise Hum banjar zameen ko zinda karte hain waise hi Hum murdon ko bhi zinda karenge jo zinda nikal aayenge.
12: Aey Rasool! In logon se pehle, jin ne aap ko jhutlaya, bohat si qaumon ne apne Ambiya ko jhutlaya. Nooh (alaihis salaam) ki qaum, kuan walon aur Samood, sab ne apne Ambiya ko jhutlaya.
13: Aad aur Firaun ki qaum ne, Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum ke saath, sab ne apne Ambiya ko jhutlaya.
14: Shoaib ki qaum, yani Aiykah walon ne bhi apne Nabi ko jhutlaya. Phir woh azaab saabit ho gaya jis ka Allah ne un se waada kiya tha.
15: To kya Hum tumhein pehli baar paida karne se aajiz the ke Hum tumhein dobara uthane se aajiz hon? Balke woh apni pehli takhleeq ke baad nayi takhleeq ke baare mein uljhan mein hain.
16: Aur beshak Hum ne insan ko paida kiya aur Hum jaante hain jo us ka nafs us se sargoshi karta hai, aur Hum us ki gardan ki rag se zyada us ke qareeb hain. Beshak Hum ne insan ko paida kiya aur Hum un khayalat aur khwahishon ko jaante hain jo us ke zehan mein guzarte hain. Hum us se us rag se zyada qareeb hain jo us ki gardan mein maujood hai aur us ke dil se judi hui hai.
17: Jab do likhne wale likhte hain, daayin aur baayin taraf baithe hue. Jab do likhne wale farishte us ke aamaal likhte hain: ek us ke daayin baitha hua, aur doosra us ke baayin baitha hua.
18: Insan koi baat nahin kehta magar us ke paas ek nigraan tayyar baitha hai. Woh koi baat nahin kehta magar yeh ke ek farishta maujood hai jo us ki har baat ka intezar kar raha hai.
19: Aur maut ki bekhudi haqq le aayegi; yahi hai jis se tu bachta tha. Maut ki takleefein ek haqeeqat hain aur aayengi; un se bachne ka koi raasta nahin. Aey gaafil insan! Yahi hai jis se tu munh pherta aur jise taalta tha.
20: Aur soor phoonka jayega. Woh wa'ade ke poore hone ka din hai. Woh farishta jo soor phoonkne par muqarrar hai use doosri baar phoonkega. Woh Qayamat ka din hai, us azaab ka din jis se kafiron aur gunahgaron ko daraya gaya.
21: Aur har jaan aayegi, us ke saath ek haankne wala aur ek gawah hoga. Har jaan ek aise farishte ke saath aayegi jo use haank raha hoga, aur ek farishta jo us ke aamaal par us ke khilaf gawahi dega.
22: Kaha jayega: 'Beshak tu is se gaflat mein tha, aur Hum ne tujh se tera parda hata diya, pas aaj teri nazar teez hai.' Is insan se, jise haanka ja raha hai, kaha jayega: beshak duniya mein tu is din ke baare mein gaflat mein tha, apni khwahishon aur lazzaton se dhoke mein aa kar. Pas Hum ne tujh se teri gaflat us azaab aur dehshat ke zariye hata di jo tu apne saamne dekh raha hai. Aaj teri nazar teez hai; tu ab woh sab dekh raha hai jis se tu gaafil tha!
23: Aur us ka saathi, yani farishta, kahega: 'Yeh hai jo mere paas tayyar hai.' Us ka saathi, woh farishta jo us par muqarrar hai, kahega: 'Yeh us ke aamaal hain jo mere paas hain aur jo main pesh karta hoon, bagair kisi izafe aur kami ke.'
24: Allah farmayega: 'Jahannam mein daal do har hath-dharm kafir ko.' Allah un do farishton se kahega, yani haankne wale aur gawahi dene wale se: 'Jahannam mein daal do har us hath-dharm shaks ko jo haqq ko jhutlata hai.'
25: 'Bhalai se rokne wale, hadd se barhne wale, shubah karne wale.' 'Jo us haqq se bohat rokne wala hai jo Allah ne us par farz kiya, Allah ki hadon se aage barhne wala, us har waade ya dhamki mein shubah karne wala jo use di gayi.'
26: 'Jis ne Allah ke saath ek doosra maabood thehraya; pas use sakht azaab mein daal do.' 'Woh jo Allah ke saath ek doosra maabood mansoob karta hai aur use ibadat mein us ka shareek banata hai. Pas use sakht azaab mein daal do.'
27: Us ka saathi, yani Shaytan, kahega: 'Aey hamare Rubb, main ne use hadd se nahin barhaya, balke woh khud haqq se door ki gumrahi mein tha.' Shaytanon mein se us ka saathi us se bari hote hue kahega: 'Aey mere Rubb! Main ne use gumrah nahin kiya; woh khud gumrahi mein tha, haqq se bohat door.'
28: Allah farmayega: 'Mere saamne na jhagado, jab ke main ne tumhein pehle hi darana pahuncha diya tha.' Allah farmayega: 'Mere saamne bahas na karo; is mein koi faida nahin, kyunke main ne tumhein duniya mein pehle hi paigham pahuncha diya un sakht darawon ke saath jo mere Rasool tumhare paas laaye un logon ke liye jin ne mera inkar kiya aur meri nafarmani ki.'
29: 'Meri baat badli nahin jaati, aur main bandon par kabhi zulm karne wala nahin.' Mere paas baat badli nahin ja sakti, aur main apne waade se nahin phirta. Main apne bandon par zulm nahin karta un ki nekiyan kam kar ke, na un ki buraiyan barha kar. Balke main unhein us ka badla deta hoon jo unhon ne kiya.
30: Jis din main Jahannam se kahoonga: 'Kya tu bhar gayi?' aur woh kahegi: 'Kya kuchh aur hai?' Us din main Jahannam se kahoonga: 'Kya tu un tamam kafiron aur gunahgaron se bhar gayi jo tujh mein daale gaye?' Woh apne Rubb ko jawab degi, kehte hue: 'Kya kuchh aur hai?' Mazeed maangte hue, apne Rubb ke liye ghusse mein.
31: Aur Jannat parhezgaron ke qareeb kar di jaayegi, door nahin. Aur Jannat un logon ke liye qareeb kar di jaayegi jo apne Rubb se darte the, us ke ahkam baja laa kar aur un cheezon se bach kar jin ki us ne ijazat nahin di. Woh us mein ki tamam niyamatein dekhenge, bagair is ke ke woh un se door ho.
32: Kaha jayega: 'Yeh hai jis ka tum se waada kiya gaya, har us shaks ke liye jo rujoo karne wala aur hifazat karne wala hai.' Un se kaha jayega: 'Yeh hai jis ka Allah ne tum mein se har us shaks se waada kiya jo apne Rubb ki taraf bohat tauba karta hai aur us ko qayam rakhta hai jo us ke Rubb ne us par farz kiya.'
33: Jo Rehman se tanhai mein darta raha aur rujoo karne wala dil le kar aaya. Jo Allah se tanhai mein darta hai, jahan use Allah ke siwa koi na dekhe, aur Allah se ek paak dil le kar milta hai jab ke woh aajizi se bohat us ki taraf rujoo karta raha.
34: 'Us mein salamati ke saath daakhil ho jao. Yeh hamesha rehne ka din hai.' Un se kaha jayega: 'Jannat mein us har cheez se poori amaan ke saath daakhil ho jao jo tumhein napasand hai. Yeh hamesha rehne ka din hai, jo kabhi khatm na hoga.'
35: Un ke liye us mein jo woh chaahein hoga, aur mere paas us se bhi zyada hai. Un ke liye us mein har woh hamesha rehne wali niyamat hogi jis ki woh khwahish karein, aur mere paas un ke liye bohat si aur niyamatein hain jo kisi aankh ne nahin dekhin, na kisi kaan ne suni aur na kisi insan ke dil mein un ka khayal aaya. Un mein se ek mera deedar hai, main paak hoon.
36: Kitni hi qaumein thin jinhein main ne Makkah walon ke in jhutlane wale mushrikon se pehle halak kar diya. Unhon ne mulkon mein talash ki is umeed par ke bhaagne ki koi jagah paa lein, lekin unhon ne use na paya.
37: Pehli qaumon ki us halaakat mein, jo bayan hui, us shaks ke liye nasihat aur sabaq hai jis ke paas samajhne ke liye dil hai, ya jo haazir dimaag ke saath tawajjo se sunta hai, aur gaafil ho kar nahin.
38: Aur main ne aasmanon ko paida kiya aur zameen ko paida kiya aur jo kuchh aasmanon aur zameen ke darmiyan hai, chhe dinon mein, apni is qudrat ke bawajood ke unhein ek hi pal mein paida kar deta, aur mujh par koi thakan na aayi jaisa Yahood kehte hain.
39: Pas sabr karein, aey Rasool, us par jo Yahood aur doosre kehte hain, aur apne Rubb ke liye Fajr ki namaz parhein, sooraj nikalne se pehle us ki ta'reef karte hue, aur Asr sooraj doobne se pehle parhein.
40: Raat mein aur namazon ke baad us ki tasbeeh karein.
41: Aey Rasool, us din suniye jab woh farishta, jo soor phoonkne par muqarrar hai, doosri baar ek qareeb jagah se pukarega.
42: Us din makhlooq dobara uthne ki chingharne wali awaaz sunegi, haqq ke saath bagair kisi shubah ke. Woh din jis mein woh use sunenge wahi din hai jis mein murde apni qabron se hisaab aur dobara uthne ke liye nikalenge.
43: Main hi hoon jo zindagi aur maut deta hai. Mere siwa koi nahin jo zindagi aur maut de. Aur Qayamat ke din bandon ka lautna sirf meri taraf hai.
44: Us din zameen un se phat jaayegi, phir woh jald nikal aayenge. Yeh mere liye ek aasan jama karna hai.
45: Main behtar jaanta hoon jo yeh jhutlane wale kehte hain. Aur aap un par zimmedaar nahin, aey Rasool, ke unhein iman qabool karne par majboor karein. Aap sirf us ke pahunchane wale hain jis ke pahunchane ka Allah ne aap ko hukm diya, pas Quran ke zariye us ko nasihat karein jo kafiron aur gunahgaron ke liye mere darawe se darta hai, kyunke darne wala hi nasihat leta hai aur yaad dilane par yaad karta hai.
